## Symptom

Jobs failed with no space left on device after a week of runs.

## Contributing factor

Job logs were written to the root filesystem with no rotation.

## Root cause

The log directory was created by hand, outside the role that installs the rotation policy.

## Preventive control

The role owns the log directory and installs its rotation; an alert fires at 80 percent.
